body:
WHAT
A burst of consecutive calls to the SAME tool (e.g. a dozen Bash calls in a row, the t11 field run's complaint) collapses into one "N × Tool" group instead of N loose rows. Promotion is lazy: the first call of a kind draws its row exactly as before; only when a SECOND consecutive call of the same tool follows does stream.js wrap both (and every further one) in a <details class="tool-run"> with a <summary class="tool-run-count"> reading "N × Tool", collapsed by default. Clicking it opens the list of calls; each call is still its own .tool-row, click-to-expand to its result exactly as before. A different tool, reasoning, or the model's own text breaks the run — the next same-tool call starts a fresh group. Session-restore replay (onSessionRestored) and the live stream both funnel through the same placeToolRow() helper, so a resumed transcript groups the same way. Subagent cards are NOT touched — each agent's card is already its own visual container. The old COMPACT/DETAILED "Detail" setting (uiSettings.detail, cinematic mode) was removed in the same change, at the user's explicit request: there is now exactly one way tool calls render.

WHY
Field run 2026-09-25 (t11, ember-1/kimi-k3): a single autonomous session ran 114 tool calls, many of them Bash back to back, and the transcript read as an unbroken wall of identical-looking rows. The owner's verdict: "still spams reasoning or job call... spam is not good we shall group them up", and separately asked for the compact/detailed toggle removed in favor of this one grouped view everywhere (main UI, TUI, and the tiled multi-pane workspace, which reuses this same code).

WHERE
app/renderer/modules/stream.js — placeToolRow(), promoteToolRun(), updateToolRunLabel(), toolRunLabel(); createToolRow()/labelToolRow() lost their cinematic branch. app/renderer/modules/landing.js — onToolCallStreaming, onToolCallStarted and onSessionRestored now call placeToolRow() instead of appending directly. app/renderer/modules/tabs.js — currentToolRun added to TAB_ACCESSORS so a tiled pane's run never leaks into another pane's. app/renderer/modules/composer.js — resetLocalViewForClear() clears currentToolRun on /clear. app/renderer/modules/state.js / dom.js / index.html — the Detail (COMPACT/DETAILED) setting removed entirely. app/renderer/styles.css — .tool-run/.tool-run-head/.tool-run-count/.tool-run-body rules; .tool-row.op-cine rule removed. The TUI equivalent (not covered by this record — TUI has no render test harness) is tui/src/engine/useEngine.ts's pendingToolRun/flushToolRun, folded into the existing commit() choke point so session-restore replay, live tool lines and everything else that calls commit() benefits automatically.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Three consecutive calls to the same tool produce exactly one .tool-run, its .tool-run-count reading "3 × Tool", containing exactly 3 .tool-row elements, closed by default.
2. Three calls to three DIFFERENT tools each stay a bare .tool-row; zero .tool-run elements exist.
3. Two same-tool calls, then a different tool, then two more of the first tool: two separate .tool-run groups of 2, never one group of 4 — a run is about CONSECUTIVE repeats, not a tool's overall count in the turn.

REVIEW NOTE
Written in an autonomous session (the owner was not available to review this live in the gateway UI at commit time, per their own "work fully autonomously" instruction for this task). Left in draft rather than self-approved to ready — decisions/0001/0005 reserve that step for a human review pass in the gateway UI. npm test and npm run test:ui do not depend on gateway freshness and were both run and are green; the gateway's own banner will report this record, and roughly a dozen others whose entryFiles this change also touched, as needing that review pass.
